question: Which option group does the MockFileSystem ctor 0x6028a60 register — name, base, map — what does the map hold, and who constructs it? This pins the single RegisterOptions site 0x6028b3a, which #4372's census lists as "not individually analysed", and the contents of its map 0x65058e0, which open PR #4528 recorded only as a lead ("still unanalysed").
